newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordanian bank assets rise slightly in February.
newsitem.headline: Jordanian bank assets rise slightly in February.

text.p: Total assets of Jordanian banks rose slightly in February to 8.876 billion dinars from 8.854 billion dinars in January, the Central Bank statistical bulletin said.
Total deposits with licensed banks rose 0.60 percent to 6.051 billion dinars but foreign currency deposits were almost unchanged at 2.31 billion dinars.
Year-on-year total assets were 6.1 percent higher from February 1996 when they stood at 8.365 billion dinars, while total deposits grew by under four percent.
NOTE -- The figures cover Jordan's 20 licensed banks including six investment banks and five subsidiaries of foreign banks operating under similar Central Bank rules.
